2027-05-31.title: Monday of the second week after Pentecost
readings: Your faith is growing abundantly, and your love for one another is increasing
“This is eternal life, that they may know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom you have sent”
2027-05-31.alt: Season of Pentecost, the week after the Second Sunday after Pentecost. No commemoration is printed in the Panchangam. The Latin Church keeps today the feast of the Visitation of the Blessed Virgin Mary, and the month of May, dedicated to the Mother of God, comes to an end.
2027-05-31.verse: And this is eternal life, that they may know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom you have sent.
theo: The Gospel today takes us into the upper room on the night before the Passion. Jesus has finished his long farewell to the disciples, and now he turns to the Father: “After Jesus had spoken these words, he looked up to heaven and said, ‘Father, the hour has come; glorify your Son so that the Son may glorify you.’” The hour is the hour of the Cross. Jesus calls it the hour of glory, because on the Cross the love of the Father and the Son will be shown to the whole world. Then he tells us what all his work has been for: “And this is eternal life, that they may know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom you have sent.” Eternal life is not only life that goes on for ever after death. It begins now, and its heart is knowing God: not knowing about him, as we know facts from a book, but knowing him as a child knows its father and a friend knows a friend. St Irenaeus put it in words the Church has never forgotten: the glory of God is a human being fully alive, and the life of a human being is the vision of God (Against Heresies IV, 20, 7, in substance). Every Holy Qurbono, every prayer of the Shehimo, every page of the Gospel read in faith is a step deeper into that knowing.

Jesus ends: “I glorified you on earth by finishing the work that you gave me to do. So now, Father, glorify me in your own presence with the glory that I had in your presence before the world existed.” The Son who speaks is not a creature who has earned a reward. He shared the Father's glory before the world began; he is God from God, light from light. Now, having taken our flesh and finished his work, he asks that this flesh, our human nature, be taken into that glory. This is what we celebrated at Suloko and at Pentecost: the risen Lord in glory at the Father's side, and the Spirit sent so that we may share his life. St Paul's prayer for the Thessalonians shows what that life looks like when it takes root in a community: “We must always give thanks to God for you, brothers and sisters, as is right, because your faith is growing abundantly, and the love of every one of you for one another is increasing.” Knowing God and loving one another grow together. A parish where faith is growing will be a parish where the love of its members is growing too.

Paul adds that this growth is taking place under pressure: “Therefore we ourselves boast of you among the churches of God for your steadfastness and faith during all your persecutions and the afflictions that you are enduring.” He speaks of God's justice, that God will one day give “relief to the afflicted as well as to us, when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels.” Christians do not take revenge; they leave judgement to God and pray for those who wrong them, as Jesus did on the Cross. Today is the last day of May, the month our people dedicate to the Mother of God, and the Latin Church keeps the feast of the Visitation. No one knew Jesus more deeply than his holy Mother. She carried him in her womb to the hill country, and Elizabeth greeted her: “blessed is she who believed that there would be a fulfillment of what was spoken to her by the Lord.” As the month of Mary closes, ask her to teach you what the Gospel calls eternal life: to know the Father and the Son whom he sent, to believe his word as she did, and to carry Christ to others in haste and in love.
outline: Ask: do I know about God, or do I know God?
Paul's thanksgiving for a church that grows under pressure.
To know the only true God and Jesus Christ whom he sent.
Point 3 · The hour of glory, and the Mother who believed
The Son glorified with the glory he had before the world; Mary who knew him best.
“This is eternal life, that they may know you, the only true God.”
live: Know him, not only about him (John 17:3)
Spend ten minutes today speaking to God in your own words, as to a Father, before any set prayer.
Do one act of kindness today for someone in your parish or family whom you do not usually notice.
2027-05-31.prayer: Father, the only true God, you sent your Son Jesus Christ, and in him you have given us eternal life: to know you and the one whom you have sent. As he glorified you on earth by finishing your work, let us glorify you by our faith and our love. Make our faith grow abundantly and our love for one another increase, even in affliction. With the holy Mother of God, who believed your word and carried your Son in haste to others, let us know your Son more deeply and bring him to those we meet. Through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, for ever. Amen.
altar: At the altar the hour of glory is made present: the Son who glorified the Father by finishing his work offers his one sacrifice, and in the Holy Qurbono we begin to know God with the knowledge that is eternal life.

quick: St Paul thanks God because the Thessalonians' faith is growing abundantly and their love for one another is increasing, even in persecution.
Jesus prays: Father, the hour has come; glorify your Son so that the Son may glorify you.
Eternal life is to know the only true God and Jesus Christ whom he sent; at the end of May we ask the Mother of God to teach us that knowing.
2027-05-31.action: Pray today in your own words, as a child speaks to a father, before saying any set prayer.
2027-05-31.question: Is my faith growing, and is my love for others increasing with it?

family.explain: On the night before he died, Jesus looked up to heaven and prayed to his Father. He said that eternal life means knowing God, not just knowing about him but knowing him like our best friend and our Father. Today is the last day of May, the month of Mary. Mary knew Jesus better than anyone, and she can help us to know him too.
family.intention: We pray that our family may know Jesus better and love one another more.
family.ask: Ask: “How can we get to know Jesus better as a family this week?”

illus: In a parish near Chengannur, a boy preparing for his First Holy Communion was asked by the catechism teacher what he knew about God. He recited everything perfectly: the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit, the Creation, the commandments. Then she asked him a second question: do you know God? He was silent for a long time. That evening he asked his grandmother how a person can know God. She took him to the corner of the house where the family prayed, lit the lamp before the picture of the Mother of God holding her Son, and said: you start by talking to him every day, as you talk to me. That is how you came to know me.

pm.open: Father, this is eternal life: to know you and Jesus Christ whom you have sent. With the holy Mother of God, let us know your Son more deeply. Amen.
share: Your faith is growing abundantly, and the love of every one of you for one another is increasing (2 Thessalonians 1:3). Where have I seen faith and love grow together?
Father, the hour has come; glorify your Son (John 17:1). What does the glory of the Cross mean to me?
This is eternal life, that they may know you (John 17:3). How do I come to know God more deeply?
pm.resp: Lord, let us know you and love you.
interc: For the Church, that her faith may grow abundantly and her love increase, especially where she suffers persecution.
For all who know about God but have not yet met him, that they may come to know him as Father.
For mothers, that like the holy Mother of God they may carry Christ to their children.
For the afflicted, that God may give them relief and strengthen their steadfastness.
For our parish, as the month of Mary ends, that we may grow in the knowledge and love of Jesus Christ.
pm.close: Father, you sent your Son to give us eternal life. Let us know you and the one whom you have sent, let our faith and love grow together, and with the holy Mother of God let us carry Christ to others. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

homily: Dear friends, St Paul gives thanks for the Christians of Thessalonica, because your faith is growing abundantly, and the love of every one of you for one another is increasing (2 Thessalonians 1:3). They are suffering persecution, and still they are growing. Faith and love grow together.

In the Gospel Jesus looks up to heaven on the night before he dies and prays: Father, the hour has come; glorify your Son so that the Son may glorify you (John 17:1). The hour of the Cross is the hour of glory, because there the love of God is shown to all.

Then Jesus tells us what eternal life is: and this is eternal life, that they may know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom you have sent (John 17:3). Eternal life begins now. It is not only knowing about God, but knowing him, as a child knows a father. We come to know him in prayer, in the Gospel and above all in the Holy Qurbono.

Today the month of May ends, the month of the Mother of God, and the Latin Church keeps the feast of the Visitation. No one knew Jesus better than his holy Mother. Let us ask her to help us know her Son, to grow in faith and in love, and to carry him to others as she carried him to Elizabeth. Amen.
kids: Children, do you know the difference between knowing about someone and knowing them? You may know about the Prime Minister, but you know your mother! Jesus said that eternal life is knowing God, really knowing him like a friend and a Father. How do we get to know God? By talking to him every day, by listening to his stories in the Bible, and by meeting Jesus in the Holy Qurbono. Today is the last day of Mary's month. Ask Mother Mary to help you know Jesus better.

concl: Eternal life begins now, in knowing the Father and the Son whom he sent, and it shows itself in growing love.
The holy Mother of God, who believed and carried Christ to others, teaches us that knowing.
2027-05-31.resolve: Seek to know God, not only to know about him, and let your faith and your love grow together.
